releases.note: Reliability repair: stamp epoll registrations with per-descriptor generations to discard stale events after a socket closes and its descriptor is reused. A standalone epoll test reproduced the stale-ready-event pattern and verified the generation mismatch; a 1,950-connection concurrent churn test returned no errors, and the visible smoke suite still passes. Admission tests on the prior tagged candidate confirmed per-client and global exhaustion, no denied origin calls, refill, and health bypass. Full host API and performance remain unverified.
